audit_scope.question: Is the current 4.4.54 backend/planner/sandbox contract stack stable enough to freeze as the engineering baseline?
audit_scope.method: Static reading of committed contracts and production, mechanical import-graph and vocabulary scans, and a full backend test-suite baseline. No redesign performed.

layer_boundaries.name: synthetic/local reference action execution
layer_boundaries.note: Local envelopes are declared SANDBOX_EXTENSION; the adapter gate forces REFERENCE_MODEL.

layer_boundaries.name: reference settlement
layer_boundaries.declared_scope: REF02 ordinary damage / explicit heal packet
layer_boundaries.note: Packet shape is exact-key; special fields are refused, not interpreted.

layer_boundaries.name: planner search
layer_boundaries.declared_scope: M11 battle search over M10 sessions; M9 resource search is a separate scope
layer_boundaries.note: Search draws zero RNG (policy asserts search_rng_draws == 0).

layer_boundaries.name: real-content identity/representation
layer_boundaries.note: Carries version_relation CLOSE_4.4.0_TO_4.4.54 with version_provenance_qualified false.

layer_boundaries.name: content capability querying
layer_boundaries.declared_scope: read-only typed query over M13 registry data
layer_boundaries.note: Only consumer of the M13 data plane; imports only battle_ir.evidence for vocabularies.

layer_boundaries.name: real-content planner admission
layer_boundaries.declared_scope: fail-closed admission; REJECTED is the only outcome
layer_boundaries.note: Depends on E only; no execution artifact imported; accepts no battle state.

layer_boundaries.name: native evidence/gate authority
layer_boundaries.declared_scope: NATIVE_EVIDENCED vocabulary and sealed gate certificates
layer_boundaries.note: Both certificate types are sealed; neither is constructible from registry data.

layer_boundary_verdict.import_direction: D -> E -> F; M10/M11 import no content layer, so no back-edge exists
evidence: no module outside content_support/content_planner imports either package

mechanisms.admission: content_planner admits nothing; outcome vocabulary is {REJECTED}
mechanisms.purity: admission accepts no battle state and imports no execution type
mechanisms.certificate: sealed construction; REFERENCE_MODEL/registry data cannot be promoted
mechanisms.version: content version is explicit; load_registry has no latest resolution or fallback
mechanisms.special_fields: SPHitRatio / HitSplitRatio are refused by the REF02 packet adapter
mechanisms.waitanimstate: typed only in the content compiler's static type mapping; no planner reads it

contract_stability.reason: slotted type with a declared schema constant and a snapshot migration module; extension is versioned, not ad hoc
frozen dataclass, exact-shape validation, namespace/version fields, declared completion and schedule policies
public surface (create/step/legal_actions/snapshot/terminal_status) is stable; step returns a new session rather than mutating

contract_stability.contract: battle planner request/result (ReferenceBattleObjective, ReferenceBattleSearchPolicy, BattlePlan, BattlePlannerResult)
contract_stability.reason: schema-tagged, from_dict/to_dict round-trip, stable identity digests
immutable typed identity with a canonical string form fixed by the M13 contract
compact frozen view over M13 data; explicitly not an authority
frozen, closed outcome vocabulary, engineered fail-closed positive path
both certificate types are sealed and require NATIVE_EVIDENCED; frozen Terra authority, must not be changed
sole-home frozen vocabularies with identity-quarantine rules
closed typed mirrors of the M13 registry vocabulary
closed now; new M14 reasons may add members, and unknown M14 reasons surface as UNMAPPED_M14_REASON meanwhile
counter set may grow as new execution artifacts appear
single-token map; a future source relation must be added deliberately and fails closed meanwhile
private field; callers must use record()/queries
private helper; the public entrypoints are admit_content_for_planner and prepare_content_plan_request
separate declared scope (SANDBOX_RESOURCE_V1) with its own fixtures

duplication_policy_leaks.search_method: vocabulary and import-graph scan over src/

findings.subject: M15 reason vocabulary renames M14 reasons
findings.detail: AdmissionReasonCode reuses several M14 reason spellings (for example BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE) as a distinct type, and M14_REASON_TO_ADMISSION_REASON is a rename table. It re-derives nothing, but the shared spelling across SupportStatus and AdmissionReasonCode is easy to misread.
findings.already_guarded_by: mapping table is explicit and documented; unmapped reasons surface visibly

findings.subject: readiness vocabulary single-sourced
findings.detail: content_support.Readiness is an alias of battle_ir.evidence.ReadinessClass, so no second copy exists. The only other occurrence of the vocabulary is its home module definition.

authoritative_layers.binding_level / support_status / blocker: M13 registry data, typed once by content_support

version_migration_readiness.evidence: M10/M11 import no content layer, so a new content version cannot require planner or sandbox changes. The M14/M15 layers are version-parameterised: load_registry takes an explicit version and the registry directory is derived from it.

small_fixes.why: a 4.5.54 registry directory will be refused until the version is registered
small_fixes.scope: one deliberate constant edit in the content layer; no planner or sandbox change

small_fixes.what: the content-production pipeline is hard-pinned to 4.4.54
small_fixes.why: game_data/external_reconstruction.py refuses any version other than its CONTENT_VERSION pin; nanoka_content.SUPPORTED_VERSION, followup_ledger.TARGET_GAME_VERSION, the behavior_compiler game_version literal and battle_ir path literals are also fixed to 4.4.54
small_fixes.scope: data-production side only; parameterising these pins is not an architecture change

small_fixes.what: M13_VERSION_RELATION_TOKEN maps exactly one close-version relation
small_fixes.why: a different source relation for 4.5.54 would fail closed with VersionRelationParseError
small_fixes.scope: additive token registration; fail-closed behaviour is correct in the meantime

freeze_decision.label: BACKEND_CONTRACT_STACK_FREEZE_READY
freeze_decision.reason: All seven boundaries are explicit and non-overlapping, the import graph is strictly layered with no back-edges, every real-content execution path is denied before any execution artifact can exist, no policy is derived outside its authoritative layer, content versions are explicit with no fallback, and the full backend suite passes. The only open items are forward-looking delta work, not defects in the current stack.
freeze_decision.would_change_to_B_if: a concrete contract incompatibility or an execution bypass is demonstrated; none was found

observations_non_blocking.subject: two distinct GateCertificate classes
observations_non_blocking.detail: battle_sandbox.gate_certificate.GateCertificate (strict-preflight permission) and battle_sandbox.evidence_boundary.GateCertificate (sealed native-contract gate) are different classes sharing a name. Neither is re-exported from battle_sandbox/__init__, so consumers must import by module path.
observations_non_blocking.risk: consumer misreading of an ambiguous name
observations_non_blocking.action: document only; this is frozen Terra authority and must not be renamed or merged

observations_non_blocking.subject: M11 plan documents carry a content_target label
observations_non_blocking.detail: reference_battle_planner.search declares CONTENT_TARGET = 'HSR-4.4.54' while its EVIDENCE block keeps action_envelope SANDBOX_EXTENSION, settlement REFERENCE_MODEL, native_trace false and golden false.
observations_non_blocking.risk: the label could be misread as a content-binding claim
observations_non_blocking.action: document only; the evidence block and the M15 denial boundary already forbid that reading

observations_non_blocking.subject: ReferenceAdapterGate is a declared, not sealed, gate
observations_non_blocking.detail: The gate is an ordinary frozen dataclass that pins evidence_mode to REFERENCE_MODEL and requires adapter id/version/sha256/scope/owner, but any caller can construct one.
observations_non_blocking.risk: hand-built local envelopes remain possible, as intended for the synthetic scope
observations_non_blocking.action: document only. The guarantee that real content cannot produce an envelope rests on (a) no content binder existing and (b) the M15 admission boundary, not on a seal; REFERENCE_MODEL can never be promoted to native evidence

observations_non_blocking.subject: several independent 4.4.54 version pins in the content pipeline
observations_non_blocking.detail: game_data and battle_ir modules each pin 4.4.54 independently; none resolves a 'latest' version, so there is no implicit selection.
observations_non_blocking.action: captured as DELTA-2; not a leak and not a blocker

non_claims: No contract was redesigned or modified.
The audit does not claim native evidence for any content.
M12 remains BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE; that is its correct state, not an audit defect.
No 4.5.54 content was read or interpreted.
